metadata.question: Was the water extent around the location (11.184384, 35.114837) greater on February 14, 2022 than on February 6, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare water extent around a specific location between two dates: February 14, 2022 vs February 6, 2019. For water detection, I should use: 1. Sentinel-2 for optical water detection (NDWI) 2. Or Sentinel-1 for SAR-based water detection (more reliable for clouds) Since the dates are specific and clouds might be an issue, I'll use Sentinel-1 SAR data which penetrates clouds. I'll use the VV polarization band and threshold around -15 to -20 dB to detect water (water typically has lower backscatter). Strategy: 1. Create a 1km buffer around the point 2. Get Sentinel-1 images for both dates (±3 days window) 3. Calculate water extent using VV threshold 4. Compare pixel counts 5. Handle edge cases (no data, no valid pixels, etc.) I'll need to: - Check collection sizes - Calculate valid pixel counts - Validate results are reasonable - Output the comparison ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([35.114837, 11.184384]); const region = point.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer // Date ranges (±3 days for each target date) const date2019 = ee.Date('2019-02-06'); const date2022 = ee.Date('2022-02-14'); const dateRange = 3; // days // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-1 for reliable water detection const s1_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2019.advance(-dateRange, 'day'), date2019.advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .sort('system:time_start'); const s1_2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2022.advance(-dateRange, 'day'), date2022.advance(dateRange, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .sort('system:time_start'); // Check collection sizes const count2019 = s1_2019.size().getInfo(); const count2022 = s1_2022.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2022 Images: ${count2022}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2022 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get closest images const img2019 = ee.Image(s1_2019.first()); const img2022 = ee.Image(s1_2022.first()); // Water detection using VV threshold (water typically < -15 dB) const waterThreshold = -15; const water2019 = img2019.select('VV').lt(waterThreshold); const water2022 = img2022.select('VV').lt(waterThreshold); // Calculate water pixel counts const waterCount2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV').getInfo(); const waterCount2022 = water2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${waterCount2019}`); console.log(`2022 Water Pixels: ${waterCount2022}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (waterCount2019 === 0 || waterCount2022 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid results if (waterCount2019 === null || waterCount2022 === null || isNaN(waterCount2019) || isNaN(waterCount2022)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare water extent const waterGreater2022 = waterCount2022 > waterCount2019; console.log(`Water extent greater in 2022: ${waterGreater2022}`); // Final answer if (waterGreater2022) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
